summary: Result: with the bubble, loading cost +0.05 CPU seconds once (0.38 → 0.43), and the steady minute +0.18 CPU seconds per minute (0.02 → 0.20) with the bars re-read every minute; the run-to-run spread was 0.02, so the steady difference is real. Chart-API reads: 12 without, 24 with (six intraday reads at mount, then six a minute at this test's refresh rate; at the recommended 10 minutes, six every ten). Well under the +2 CPU seconds per minute ceiling the RSI-fan lane worked to.
